release.name: v1.15.0-polaris-alpha.12
release.body:
GitHub-only unsigned build/package prerelease from c0023dbc6dcd7b6eb2f54dd036ae150168bd8e6e. Not a complete signed installable release.

Clients are sing-box-polaris derivatives of the fixed SagerNet upstream clients, not official SagerNet releases. Original authors and license texts are retained. Candidate paths and renamed public assets are mapped in the receipt.

- Signed installable iOS and tvOS IPA exports require owned signing and provisioning.
- Signed macOS App Store PKG and Developer ID signed/notarized standalone PKG require owned signing.
- Store/TestFlight submissions and registry pushes are outside this GitHub-only release.

See polaris-github-release-receipt-1.15.0-polaris-alpha.12.json for actual hashes, run IDs, scope and signature states.
